about: Vectors for the two checks an MPP resource server makes before anything moves, and their order (mpp-charge.md, The server's order): place with the position and the act the caller gives, an agreement challenge stating expires, tie and issuedDigest over a challenge as its pairing's unplaced gives it, the echoed id held whole to the id recorded at issue, the order of the checks, an agreement challenge composed anew in the position of the one it replaces, and an echoed opaque that is an object. The order of the steps has no outside oracle; the encodings it starts from are the profile's, as below. Every expected value was computed from the profile with Python 3.12.3's json, base64 and hashlib: RFC 8785 as json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) over these values, which hold ASCII keys and no fractions; base64url without padding; SHA-256. The credentials are those of mpp-charge-evm-authorization.json (buyer B6), mpp-charge-xrpl.json (place, refusals[0]) and mpp-charge-card.json (M1), with the changes each row's case names. C_E, H, the link and the agreement URL are mpp-challenge.json's.

place.case: place([C_E], H, link, C_E, position, agreementUrl?): the id is base64url(H) '.' position; opaque is base64url of RFC 8785 {legalContext, legalContextUrl[, legalContextAgreementUrl]}

rows.case: an agreement challenge at position 5, in a response of its own
position 0 with the agreement URL
position 31, the last an id holds
position 32, outside an id
position -1
position 2.5
position given as the string 5
no position (null) for a charge challenge

taken.case: a response holding C_E placed at 5, then C_O, C_E under another realm, placed: at 5 its id would be C_E's, at 6 it is placed

rows.case: C_O at position 5
C_O at position 6

subscription.case: a Tempo subscription challenge takes no position (null); its id is base64url(H) alone

rows.case: null
position 0

again.case: the agreement challenge composed again for a re-challenge: the same option at the same position gives the same challenge, byte for byte, and the same issued digest

agreement.case: place's act: an agreement challenge states expires; C_X is C_E admitting authorization and transaction, without expires, so the filter still offers transaction

rows.case: C_X as a payment challenge at position 5
C_X as an agreement challenge at position 5
C_E as an agreement challenge at position 5
C_E with an act that is neither payment nor agreement

unplaced.case: the pairings whose quote or invoice the seller writes after H: tie binds, and issuedDigest digests, the challenge without the members written after H, so the challenge as issued and as placed give one slot entry and one digest

rows.case: mpp/charge/nearintents: the issued challenge and the placed one, whose request carries externalId; both read without the quote's members, refundTo and expires
mpp/charge/lightning: the challenge with its invoice, placed, and without it
mpp/charge/evm/authorization, whose seller writes nothing after H: the slot holds the challenge as given

order.case: Each row presents a credential to the resource server that recorded `recorded` for the challenge it issued. Check 1: challengeBound, given the id the resource server recorded when it issued the challenge (`recordedId`), gives H, and issuedDigest of the echoed challenge equals `recorded`. Check 2: the pairing's bound gives H. A credential is taken (step 3) only where both pass; `first` names the first step that refuses, in that order, or is null

rows.case: the credential as built: both checks pass
the echoed request's amount changed: bound, which judges nothing the payment pays, still gives H, and check 1 refuses it
opaque names another H
the id derives from another H
mpp/charge/card, coverage none: bound finds no H in what the payer signed; the second check is the pairing's link and the resource server's record that the agreement for H is recorded
mpp/charge/xrpl, a credential its payer broadcast: bound reads H only once fetchPresented has read the landed transaction

opaqueObject.case: A credential whose echoed challenge carries `opaque` as the decoded object, as mppx 0.6.3's Credential.serialize writes it (src/Credential.ts, the challenge spread with opaque as Challenge.ts's Record<string, string>), is read by its members, as mppx 0.6.5's Credential.deserialize reads it

rows.case: the object of the credential's own opaque
the object names another H
a member that is not a string
an array

id.case: challengeBound holds the echoed id whole to the id the resource server recorded when it issued that challenge (`recorded`): the part after H is the challenge's position, so an id of H at another position, or of another H at the recorded position, is not it; a recorded id that is not an id in the form challengeId writes is the caller's fault, before the credential is read

rows.case: the recorded id itself
an echoed id of H at position 1, the recorded id at 0
an echoed id of another H at the recorded position, opaque naming H
a recorded id with position 32

recompose.case: an agreement challenge composed anew once its expires has passed, in the position of the one it replaces: the same id; the resource server records the new digest; a credential of the replaced challenge passes the id check and is refused at issuedDigest, whose bound members hold expires and not the id
